description: Wood resource trees and harvested stumps for the Tiny Swords asset pack. Live trees are 8-frame horizontal sprite sheets exported from Trees.aseprite; stumps are static sprites.

props.order: After ground tiles, cliff bases, and stair ramps; before top overlays (clouds, etc.).
props.note: Props at the same tile row are drawn in map order; props further south (higher y) draw on top of props further north.

anchor.note: Bottom-centre of the frame meets the ground tile.

footprint.note: Collision/placement occupies one 64x64 tile; sprite artwork extends above and sideways.

usage.summary: Animated tree variant (Tree 1). Loop all 8 frames at 10 fps.
usage.note: Each frame is 192x256. Anchor bottom-centre on a walkable grass tile. Edit timing in Trees.aseprite if needed.

onLandOnly.rule: Place only on land cells (elevation >= 0). Never on water, cliff-face cells, cliff-base cells, or stair/ramp cells.
onLandOnly.appliesTo: Walkable grass at any elevation tier.
onLandOnly.doNotApply: Water (elevation -1), cells below south-facing cliffs, ramp landing/top cells, or shoreline edge tiles where the wide sprite would overhang water or cliffs.

preferInteriorGrass.rule: Prefer fully-surrounded centre grass (autotile piece 5, mask 1111) so the 192px-wide sprite does not bleed over terrain edges.

anchor.note: Bottom-centre of the frame meets the ground tile.

footprint.note: Collision/placement occupies one 64x64 tile; sprite artwork extends above and sideways.
